title: A Parcel Bound East
summary: Corin Bell has a parcel that needs to travel east faster than he does.

stages.text: Corin's parcel is meant for a clinic in the mountains. First it has to be logged at the East Road Relay.
stages.hint: Follow the east road out of the village. The relay is a long way out, past the watchtower and the woods.

objectives.text: Have the parcel logged at the relay

completion_text: The parcel is logged for the eastern route.
